description: This file implements a secrets auditing module for a software project, including functions for collecting secrets, detecting plaintext secrets, resolving secret references, and generating audit reports. It defines types for audit findings, statuses, and reports, and contains core logic for performing security checks on configuration files, environment variables, and secret references.

classes.name: RefAssignment
classes.description: Represents a secret reference assignment within a configuration file, including file location, JSON path, reference details, expected value type, and provider.

classes.name: ProviderAuthState
classes.description: Tracks the authentication state for a provider, indicating if static or OAuth credentials are usable and the modes involved.

classes.name: SecretDefaults
classes.description: Defines default secret input locations such as environment variable, file, or executable.

classes.name: AuditCollector
classes.description: Aggregates findings, secret reference assignments, provider reference paths, provider authentication states, and scanned files during an audit.

methods.name: isLikelySensitiveModelProviderHeaderName
methods.description: Determines if a header name is likely sensitive based on known header names and fragments.

methods.name: addFinding
methods.description: Adds a secret audit finding to the collector.

methods.name: collectProviderRefPath
methods.description: Records the configuration path for a provider reference, used for shadowing detection.

methods.name: trackAuthProviderState
methods.description: Tracks the authentication state and modes for a provider.

methods.name: collectEnvPlaintext
methods.description: Scans environment variable files for potential secrets stored as plaintext.

methods.name: collectConfigSecrets
methods.description: Analyzes configuration targets for secret references and plaintext secrets.

methods.name: collectAuthStoreSecrets
methods.description: Reads and analyzes stored authentication profiles for plaintext secrets and legacy residues.

methods.name: collectAuthJsonResidue
methods.description: Detects legacy static API key credentials in old auth.json files.

methods.name: collectModelsJsonSecrets
methods.description: Analyzes models.json for unresolved secret references and plaintext secrets.

methods.name: collectUnresolvedRefFindings
methods.description: Resolves secret references and reports unresolved or improperly resolved secrets.

methods.name: collectShadowingFindings
methods.description: Detects shadowed secret references due to provider credential precedence.

methods.name: summarizeFindings
methods.description: Summarizes the audit findings into counts of plaintext, unresolved, shadowed, and legacy residues.

methods.name: runSecretsAudit
methods.description: Main function to perform a comprehensive secrets audit, returning a detailed report.

methods.name: resolveSecretsAuditExitCode
methods.description: Determines the process exit code based on the audit report and check mode.
